MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader bundle fits my repeated use of SD and microSD cards, giving me another option for storing and transferring files.",
    "That bundle connects to both my memory card purchases and my USB card reader purchase, so it serves a familiar task with devices I already use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The NAS drive offers storage, but it requires a different setup from the removable cards I regularly use. I have no current NAS project.",
    "The motherboard and thermal paste assume I am building or servicing a desktop, while my purchases mostly involve accessories for existing devices.",
    "The earbuds, subwoofer, alarm kit, table, and Wi-Fi extender address needs I have not expressed. Owning a tablet or TV does not mean I currently need those additions."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any electronic device, regardless of what I would use it for.",
    "My storage purchases seem to have been treated as interchangeable, even though a removable memory card and an internal NAS drive solve different problems."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly choose practical accessories such as cards, cables, mounts, protective cases, and readers that support equipment I already own.",
    "Compatibility matters: the connector, card format, mount size, or supported device determines whether an accessory will actually be useful to me.",
    "My camera accessories and recent lens cap purchase make camera support items more natural possibilities than equipment for an unrelated new setup."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The memory card bundle understood my recurring accessory needs, but most other suggestions assumed new projects or needs that my purchases do not establish."
}
